results.title: Buffet Infinity
results.overview: When a massive monster buffet threatens their Alberta county, local business owners star in low-budget TV commercials that mask a dark conspiracy and unleash terrifying supernatural powers.

results.title: How to live with...?
results.overview: Luisa is diagnosed with HIV. The fear of revealing this to her family and drives her to emigrate, but just as she begins to adapt to her new city, her plans change and she must return to her country. The film offers a contemporary look at HIV, providing an intimate portrait of relationships, family and the quest for identity.

results.title: Splash City
results.overview: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

results.title: Brenda
results.overview: In 1994 New Orleans (right before the internet), two married weed dealers face a dilemma when their five-year-old son overhears their code name for marijuana and tries to solve the mystery of his parents’ imaginary friend. The movie shares a name with the code word: BRENDA.

results.title: Past Life
results.overview: When an unemployed reporter is hypnotized as part of a past life regression event, he wakes not with memories of life as royalty or some other glamorous person, but instead finds himself haunted by the memories of a serial killer.

results.title: Devil Boy
results.overview: Turkish stand-up comedian Baturay Özdemir performs "Devil Boy" (Şeytan Çocuk), a show he toured for three years before recording it. He works through the chaos of metropolitan life, the shifting dynamics of your thirties, generational friction and the fear of having children, returning throughout to the devil boy of his own childhood.

results.title: The Phantom Pain of Rojava
results.overview: Five friends reside in a home for injured guerrillas in Rojava, a post-war region. Portrays the hopes and dreams of the soldiers, who were once the world's heroes but are now abandoned in their fight for equality in the Middle East.

results.title: The time my friend Charles shook hands with Oliver Stone

results.overview: This one time, my buddy Charles shook hands with Oliver Stone, what happened next was crazy!

results.title: Notre Enfance
results.overview: For two weeks, around twenty young musicians from the northern districts of Marseille come to train every day and rehearse three jazz pieces.

results.title: True Love
results.overview: Elliot wants to reconnect with his ex-boyfriend, Will, but a dark turn reveals the true nature of their relationship.

results.title: Blueberries

results.title: The Big Fat Quiz of Telly

results.overview: Who shot Mr Burns? What are The Chasers' nicknames? And what's 'The Peppa Effect'? Harry Hill, Judi Love, Tom Allen, Joanne McNally, Sam Campbell and Susan Wokoma take Jimmy Carr's TV test.

results.title: Detective Chen 2
results.overview: In 1930s Shanghai, a wrongly accused hero escapes death row and unravels a deadly conspiracy, battling enemies and uncovering a foreign plot that threatens his nation.

results.title: Will You Care If I Die?
results.original_title: Blir du ledsen om jag dör?
results.overview: When youth worker Nic crosses paths with Elijah, a troubled teenager with undeniable basketball talent, he sees more than just a boy in need of help. Determined to steer him away from a destructive path, Nic takes Elijah under his wing, risking personal and professional boundaries to help him realize his potential both on and off the court. Against all rules and without anyone else's knowledge, Nic offers Elijah to move in with him. This marks the beginning of a close relationship, and the encounter with Elijah also helps Nic gain a deeper understanding of himself.

results.title: Chien bleu et autres belles histoires de l'école des loisirs
results.original_title: Chien bleu et autres belles histoires de l'école des loisirs

results.title: Lovesong
results.overview: The play revolves around a couple, William and Margaret/Billy and Maggie, who are depicted at two key stages in their lives. After forty years of marriage, Maggie is ill and riddled with pain. As they enter the final week of her life, the house becomes full with memories of their marriage and their desperation to conceive a child. Past and present literally intertwine as the older and younger couples move around each other across the stage. Originally a 75 page play, this rendition was cut down to 50 pages to be a part of a greater festival. There were only 10 allotted rehearsals for this piece.

results.title: Serve
results.overview: Generation Z has swiped away the old illusion-based structure of society and moves through a city whose surfaces simultaneously reflect desire, labour and visibility. »To serve« becomes an invitation to perform and to consider the cost of becoming visible. In the social choreographies of the film, femme bodies perform a Delulu script, glowing through the urban canyons of New York that reveals itself as a bygone hypercapitalist fiction. Yet they still invent their own grammar of desire.

results.title: With You
results.overview: No matter what comes next, I'm with you.

results.title: Eliminate Criminals
results.overview: In 1995, in the city of Jixiong in northeastern China, two robbers wearing burlap sack masks killed many people and committed a robbery.  Everyone at the scene was killed. The cruelty of the crime left the entire city in shock. The police station director ordered the criminal police captain, Zhang Jian, to investigate the case.  Jiang Hongbing, who had retired from the martial arts world for many years, decided to team up with Captain Zhang Jian to avenge his fallen comrade. As a result of the killer's meticulousness, what difficulties will they face in tracking down the case, and how will they uncover the clues to solve it?

results.title: Fennel
results.overview: During a tense lunch, a father and son struggle to connect. Fennel is a quiet, intimate look at the emotional distance between parent and child and the words left unsaid.
